results.update: The file has been with the carrier's appraiser since early March awaiting his written position. He has requested photos and asked to discuss the file by phone along the way, and the most recent status update went out on July 20.

results.update: The carrier's appraiser inspected the property on July 15, and on August 8 Joseph sent him the estimate file for this claim. The file now awaits the carrier's appraiser's written position.

results.update: Joseph's own inspection was delayed because the homeowner was slow to confirm and is now set for August 18. The carrier's appraiser already inspected the property and reported no roof damage, so Joseph's position is the next step once his inspection is complete.

results.update: The joint inspection was completed on July 23, and the carrier's appraiser's position arrived August 6. It is now under Joseph's review as the file works toward an agreement.
